idx_activity_items_epoch.name: idx_activity_items_epoch
columns: CASE WHEN ts IS NULL THEN NULL WHEN CAST(ts AS REAL) < 1000000000000 THEN CAST(CAST(ts AS REAL) * 1000 AS INTEGER) ELSE CAST(ts AS INTEGER) END DESC

idx_agent_endpoints_roster_recency.name: idx_agent_endpoints_roster_recency
columns:
CASE
      WHEN "updated_at" IS NULL THEN NULL
      WHEN CAST("updated_at" AS REAL) < 1000000000000
        THEN CAST(CAST("updated_at" AS REAL) * 1000 AS INTEGER)
      ELSE CAST("updated_at" AS INTEGER)
    END desc

route_alias_bindings_target_shape_check.name: route_alias_bindings_target_shape_check
route_alias_bindings_target_shape_check.value:
(
    ("route_alias_bindings"."target_kind" = 'agent' AND "route_alias_bindings"."target_agent_id" IS NOT NULL AND "route_alias_bindings"."target_session_id" IS NULL AND "route_alias_bindings"."target_endpoint_id" IS NULL AND "route_alias_bindings"."target_harness" IS NULL)
    OR
    ("route_alias_bindings"."target_kind" = 'session' AND "route_alias_bindings"."target_agent_id" IS NOT NULL AND "route_alias_bindings"."target_session_id" IS NOT NULL AND "route_alias_bindings"."target_endpoint_id" IS NOT NULL AND "route_alias_bindings"."target_harness" IS NOT NULL)
  )
